content.title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Release Date and Start Times
content.text: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream is nearly here, ending a 13-year wait for fans of Nintendo's wonderfully unhinged life-sim series. The Switch is already home to some of the best cosy games around, and this one looks set to push things even further into delightful chaos.When does Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream release?Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream launches on April 16, 2026. Nintendo confirmed this date officially, and a free demo is already available if you want to get a feel for the game before committing. The demo is live now on the Nintendo Switch eShop, so there is no reason to go in blind on day one.The game marks the series' return after more than a decade away. The title includes features like weddings and expanded relationship mechanics that go well beyond what the original offered. You can build up an island, customise items, start families, and apparently populate the place with aliens and teddy bears if that is what you want.Build your dream islandWhat time does Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream unlock?Nintendo has not confirmed an official unlock time, but based on the standard release pattern for Nintendo first-party titles, the game is expected to go live at 9:00 PM PT on April 15, which means most players in North America will have access before midnight on the 15th.Here is the full regional breakdown based on that expected window:Region / Time ZoneExpected Launch TimePacific Time (PT)9:00 PM, April 15Central Time (CT)11:00 PM, April 15Eastern Time (ET)12:00 AM, April 16Brasilia Time (BRT)1:00 AM, April 16British Summer Time (BST)5:00 AM, April 16Central European Summer Time (CEST)6:00 AM, April 16China Standard Time (CST)12:00 PM, April 16Korean Standard Time (KST)1:00 PM, April 16Japan Standard Time (JST)1:00 PM, April 16Australian Eastern Time (AET)2:00 PM, April 16New Zealand Standard Time (NZST)4:00 PM, April 16warningThese times are based on Nintendo's typical release pattern and have not been officially confirmed. Check the Nintendo eShop closer to launch for any updates to the exact unlock time.What platforms is the game available on?Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream is a Nintendo Switch exclusive. The April 16 release date applies to the Nintendo Switch version, and no other platforms have been announced.The game is a Nintendo first-party title, so a Switch 2 version or cross-compatibility has not been confirmed at this point. Based on available information, plan for Switch only.infoIf you are picking this up digitally, pre-loading is worth checking on the eShop ahead of the April 15 evening unlock so you are not waiting on a download at launch time.What can you do in Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream?The game builds on the original Tomodachi Life formula in several key ways. You create Miis and populate an island with them, then watch their lives unfold in ways that range from wholesome to genuinely bizarre. Relationships develop, families form, and the island grows based on your decisions.Weddings are a confirmed feature, expanding the relationship systems from the original game. Beyond that, item customisation and island building give you more direct control over the world than the 2013 Nintendo 3DS original allowed.The series has always been at its best when you fill it with people you actually know, so start thinking about which friends and family members are getting Mii treatment first.For more Nintendo Switch guides and upcoming release coverage, browse the latest guides on GAMES.GG to stay up to date as launch day approaches.
